title: pvResampleWithDataset
body:
## pvResampleWithDataset

Samples the arrays of SourceDataArrays at the points of DestinationMesh: the output has the destination's geometry and structure, and its point data holds the source's point and cell values interpolated at each destination point plus a vtkValidPointMask array marking points found inside the source. Both inputs may be composite. Use it to transfer a solution onto another mesh, e.g. CFD results onto a structural or measurement mesh; resample is the curated version and pvResampleToImage samples onto a generated image.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Sampled values are always point data, even for cell-centred source fields.
- Destination points outside the source have vtkValidPointMask 0 and meaningless values; filter on the mask or enable MarkBlankPointsAndCells.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ResampleWithDataset`. Identity: `filters/ResampleWithDataset`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DestinationMesh` | Required data input for the native DestinationMesh port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the dataset whose geometry will be used in determining positions to probe. The mesh comes from this dataset. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); composite data (multiblock or partitioned collections) (vtkCompositeDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet","vtkCompositeDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
| `SourceDataArrays` | Required data input for the native SourceDataArrays port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the dataset from which to obtain probe values. The data attributes come from this dataset. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); composite data (multiblock or partitioned collections) (vtkCompositeDataSet); hyper-tree grids (adaptive AMR-like trees) (vtkHyperTreeGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet","vtkCompositeDataSet","vtkHyperTreeGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CategoricalData` | Control whether the source point data is to be treated as categorical. If the data is categorical, then the resultant data will be determined by a nearest neighbor interpolation scheme rather than by linear interpolation. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `CellLocator` | The cell locator to use for finding cells for probing. | `{"type":"typed proxy","choices":["BSP Tree Cell Locator","Cell Locator","OBB Tree Cell Locator","Static Cell Locator","Tree Cell Locator"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `{"type":"Cell Locator"}` |
| `ComputeTolerance` | Set whether to compute the tolerance or to use a user provided value. On by default. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `MarkBlankPointsAndCells` | When set, points that did not get valid values during resampling, and cells containing such points, are marked as blank. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `PassCellArrays` | Keeps the DestinationMesh's own cell arrays in the output. Source cell values are never passed as cells; they are sampled to the destination points. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `PassFieldArrays` | Set whether to pass the field-data arrays from the Input i.e. the input providing the geometry to the output. On by default. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `PassPartialArrays` | Set whether to partial data arrays from the Input i.e. the input providing the geometry to the output. Off by default. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `PassPointArrays` | Keeps the DestinationMesh's own point arrays in the output next to the values sampled from SourceDataArrays. When false, the points carry only the sampled arrays and vtkValidPointMask. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ReduceOutputMemoryUsage` | **IMPORTANT:** this option only concerns Hyper Tree Grids sources (including composite source containing HTGs). If checked, the filter will optimize the space allocated to store the output probed values. This option will lower the memory consumption, especially if the probed source contains a lot of data arrays, at the cost of an increased computation time. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `SnapToCellWithClosestPoint` | Set whether to snap to the cell with the closest point, if no cell has been found while FindCell is executed. Note: This is useful only when the source is a vtkPointSet. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Tolerance` | Set the tolerance to use for vtkDataSet::FindCell | `{"minimum":2.220446049250313e-16,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `2.220446049250313e-16` |
